The '''Chirpa–Gorneesh peace summit''' was an attempted reconciliation between the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] and [[Gorneesh's tribe]] of [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. It failed due to an attempt by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]] to apprehend the foreigner [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Plooz]], which was coupled with a Dulok plot to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the Ewok elders.
